# msdoc-viewer (unmodified runtime subset)

This directory contains an unmodified subset of the public `msdoc-viewer`
source used to read legacy MS-DOC character properties and the documented
`sprmCPicLocation` value. No upstream code is used to interpret mathematics in
MTEF.

## Verified provenance

- Project: `msdoc-viewer`
- Repository from which this copy was obtained:
  `https://github.com/zheng2429/msdoc-viewer.git`
- Commit: `cd1481b62a7f2b51e532884b3057b76e1be8e3a6`
- Git tree: `e8b6839e1f8d3f3fe9440ade6a9eb51125668c27`
- Version declared by `package.json` at that commit: `0.5.5`
- License declared by the upstream `package.json` and README: MIT
- Local modifications to the eight files listed below: none

The declared version `0.5.5` is not a published npm version and no Git tag
`0.5.5` exists in the repository examined. It is therefore described here only
as the version declared by `package.json` at the pinned commit.

The upstream metadata contains historical references to
`wybaby168/msdoc-viewer`. Those references are preserved as historical upstream
metadata, but they are not used as proof of the origin of this local copy. The
demonstrated source of this copy is the repository and commit stated above.

No explicit copyright holder or copyright notice was found in the upstream
source examined. No holder, name, or year is inferred or invented here.
